title: Product cover local bases for a direct sum
statement: Under the hypotheses of the locally free direct sum lemma, the product family generates the unit ideal and each product localization of the direct sum has a basis of rank n₁+n₂.

proof.text: Multiply the two unit-ideal linear combinations and extend the two local bases across the localization tower; tensor products commute with finite products.

lean.statement:
theorem locallyFreeCharpoly_prodCover
    {A : Type u} {M₁ : Type v₁} {M₂ : Type v₂} [CommRing A]
    [AddCommGroup M₁] [Module A M₁] [AddCommGroup M₂] [Module A M₂]
    {n₁ n₂ r₁ r₂ : ℕ} (f₁ : Fin r₁ → A) (f₂ : Fin r₂ → A)
    (hgen₁ : Ideal.span (Set.range f₁) = ⊤)
    (hgen₂ : Ideal.span (Set.range f₂) = ⊤)
    (hfree₁ : ∀ i : Fin r₁,
      ∃ _e : Module.Basis (Fin n₁) (Localization.Away (f₁ i))
        (LocalizedModule.Away (f₁ i) M₁), True)
    (hfree₂ : ∀ j : Fin r₂,
      ∃ _e : Module.Basis (Fin n₂) (Localization.Away (f₂ j))
        (LocalizedModule.Away (f₂ j) M₂), True) :
    let g : Fin (r₁ * r₂) → A := fun k ↦
      f₁ (finProdFinEquiv.symm k).1 * f₂ (finProdFinEquiv.symm k).2
    ∃ (hggen : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤)
      (hgfree : ∀ k : Fin (r₁ * r₂),
        ∃ _e : Module.Basis (Fin (n₁ + n₂)) (Localization.Away (g k))
          (LocalizedModule.Away (g k) (M₁ × M₂)), True), True
